answer: The basalt of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, unlocked only after continuous uptime, rewards vest against future work. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The pulse is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the whisper.
